answer: Witness-ticket binding: each identity must route actions through a randomly assigned relay, which signs a per-epoch ticket. Any two tickets sharing a relay echo incur a fixed penalty charged to both identities, so coordination leaves a trace. Each identity pays the relay's full ticket price and a delay to cross the bridge of independent routing. An extra violet mark flags clusters for audit. Attacker cost scales with cluster size since every identity pays full price, and a single linked pair forfeits all tickets.
